verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Appwrite requires an APPWRITE_API_KEY to run its MCP server (credential-gated), but there is no documentation or hands-on evidence describing scoped or least-privilege API key creation, granular permission scopes, or any mechanism for issuing an agent-specific restricted credential. Missing for 10: docs on API key scopes/permissions, evidence of scoping granularity, and any agent-specific credential issuance workflow.
